summary: Build adoption plans, stakeholder maps, and dashboards for successful digital change. Enroll in practical 5-day training.
lede: Digital adoption and change enablement prepares professionals to plan and support system rollouts so people can use new workflows effectively. For change managers, transformation leads, digital adoption specialists, business analysts and IT change leads, it covers assessing readiness and impacts, mapping stakeholders, and planning communications and role-based training. Learners also use system usage, help-desk and user feedback measures to build adoption dashboards, address resistance, and plan post-launch reinforcement.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who manage digital rollout adoption, coordinate behavioural change, and report transformation progress to sponsors and operational leaders.
prerequisites: Recommended prerequisites: working experience in project delivery, business analysis, operations improvement, or IT change coordination; familiarity with one digital rollout or process change initiative; and a basic ability to interpret adoption metrics such as usage logs, ticket trends, or training completion data. No coding is required. Participants should bring a laptop and be prepared to work with templates, change case scenarios, and sample adoption dashboards. Advanced change portfolio design is introduced at an operational level, not as a technical engineering track.
